included: Rentals include paddles and life jackets
facts.description: Nestled within McArthur-Burney Falls Memorial State Park, the marina offers easy access to calm waters perfect for paddling. Whether you're looking to explore the shoreline, spot local wildlife, or enjoy a peaceful day on the lake, our canoes provide a fun and relaxing way to experience the outdoors. They are available by the hour or day-no experience necessary. Come enjoy the natural splendor of Burney Falls from the water!
